protocol.split: same stratified 70/15/15 split as the main pipeline
protocol.thresholds: t_high and t_low tuned on validation only; applied to the test probabilities
protocol.preprocessing: fit on each CV training fold; final preprocessor fit on the full training split
protocol.resampling: training rows only, after preprocessing, within each CV fold and for the final fit
protocol.smote_limitation: SMOTE is applied after one-hot encoding; synthetic rows can have fractional one-hot values. This keeps the same numeric preprocessing interface across both models.
protocol.medium_undersampling: RandomUnderSampler reduces Medium Risk to the larger of the High Risk and Low Risk counts in that training fold/split.
protocol.class_weight: per-row sample_weight from sklearn balanced inverse-frequency formula
